svg.text: Selected 96/16/16 episode split; raw-feature heads score all 20 axes.
Raw128 baselines are filled polygons; metadata, Qwen3, and Cosmos branches plot only evaluated task targets.
Each axis is one task. Longer radius means better after metric-direction normalization.
Each method has 20 records; scored axes and scoreless statuses stay in the JSON matrix.
128-episode aligned simple baselines: JSONL metadata/text tasks plus staged
sensor-block tasks where the processed target exists.
128-episode aligned MLP baselines: JSONL metadata/text tasks plus staged
sensor-block tasks where the processed target exists.
128-episode 4430-dim sensor NPZ simple heads; tasks 15/19 use compact proxies.
128-episode 4430-dim sensor NPZ MLP heads; tasks 15/19 use compact proxies.
Verified held-out Qwen3-Omni v6 LoRA metrics, plus task 16 and any completed
private-GPU future-task probes scored from task-specific JSON.
Verified Cosmos3-Super base-weight Reasoner JSON-task evaluation, plus task 16
scored from existing verified action/object JSON.
Full task names are listed here so the polygon remains readable at homepage scale.
Every 128-episode method has 20 result records; radius appears only where a numeric score exists.
Raw128 Simple and Raw128 NN are complete 20/20 scored multi-episode baselines; tasks 15/19 are documented compact proxies.
Qwen3/Cosmos task 16 uses existing verified action/object JSON; other scoreless cells remain explicit not-supported or not-evaluated records.
